concerns.text: No task explicitly verifies the success criterion RMSE ≤ 0.5 eV (SC‑001). T010 produces RMSE values but does not assert the threshold, and no separate task checks that the model meets this criterion before proceeding.
No task explicitly verifies the success criterion R² ≥ 70 % (SC‑002). While T010 records R², there is no dedicated verification step that asserts the threshold is satisfied.

The specification requires ≥ 500 valid samples, yet T004 only logs a warning when fewer than 500 rows are present and continues execution. There is no task that enforces this requirement or fails the pipeline if the sample count is insufficient.
